preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the graph is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
Each edge connects two nodes within the range from 1 to n.
The graph is guaranteed to be connected, meaning there is a path between any two nodes.

postconditions.expression: output is a permutation of nodes a_1, a_2, ..., a_n
postconditions.description: The output is a sequence of nodes that Bob can record, representing his wandering path, and it is a permutation of all nodes in the graph.
The output sequence is the lexicographically smallest possible sequence that Bob can record while wandering the graph.
